nodes.label: Swift
nodes.definition: Apple's programming language for iOS, macOS, and other platforms.

nodes.label: Array
nodes.definition: A collection of elements stored at contiguous memory locations.

nodes.label: Array Element
nodes.definition: An individual item within an array.

nodes.label: Index
nodes.definition: A numerical value that identifies the position of an element in an array.

nodes.label: Array Properties
nodes.definition: Attributes of an array such as count, isEmpty, etc.

nodes.label: Array Methods
nodes.definition: Functions that can be performed on an array, such as append, remove, etc.

nodes.label: Modifiers
nodes.definition: Functions that modify the appearance or behavior of a view in SwiftUI.

nodes.label: Padding
nodes.definition: A modifier that adds space around a view.

nodes.label: Background
nodes.definition: A modifier that sets the background of a view.

nodes.label: Frame
nodes.definition: A modifier that sets the size and position of a view.

nodes.label: ForegroundColor
nodes.definition: A modifier that sets the foreground color of a view.

nodes.label: Font
nodes.definition: A modifier that sets the font of text in a view.

nodes.label: Resizable
nodes.definition: A modifier that allows an image to be resized.

nodes.label: Container Views
nodes.definition: Views that contain and arrange other views, such as HStack, VStack, ZStack.

nodes.label: HStack
nodes.definition: A container view that arranges its children in a horizontal line.

nodes.label: VStack
nodes.definition: A container view that arranges its children in a vertical line.

nodes.label: ZStack
nodes.definition: A container view that overlays its children on top of each other.

nodes.label: Spacer
nodes.definition: A flexible space that expands to fill available space in a stack.

nodes.label: Stack Views
nodes.definition: Container views that arrange child views linearly, such as HStack and VStack.

nodes.label: View Hierarchy
nodes.definition: The tree-like structure of views in a SwiftUI application.

nodes.label: Interactive Views
nodes.definition: Views that respond to user interaction, such as Button, TextField, Slider, Toggle.

nodes.label: Button
nodes.definition: A control that performs an action when tapped.

nodes.label: TextField
nodes.definition: A control that displays an editable text interface.

nodes.label: Slider
nodes.definition: A control for selecting a value from a continuous range.

nodes.label: Toggle
nodes.definition: A control that switches between on and off states.

nodes.label: @State Property Wrapper
nodes.definition: A property wrapper that manages mutable state in a SwiftUI view.

nodes.label: Constants
nodes.definition: Values that cannot be changed after declaration.

nodes.label: Variables
nodes.definition: Values that can be changed after declaration.

nodes.label: Data Types
nodes.definition: Categories of data such as Int, String, Bool, etc.

nodes.label: Loop Structures
nodes.definition: Control flow constructs that repeat a block of code, such as for-in, while.

nodes.label: Conditional Statements
nodes.definition: Control flow constructs that execute code based on conditions, such as if, switch.

nodes.label: Flow of Execution
nodes.definition: The order in which statements are executed in a program.

nodes.label: Color
nodes.definition: A type representing a color in SwiftUI.

nodes.label: View
nodes.definition: A basic building block of a user interface in SwiftUI.

nodes.label: Identify
nodes.definition: To recognize or point out.

nodes.label: Modify
nodes.definition: To change or alter.

nodes.label: Use
nodes.definition: To employ for a purpose.

nodes.label: Evaluate
nodes.definition: To assess or determine the value.

nodes.label: Implement
nodes.definition: To put into effect or execute.

nodes.label: Demonstrate
nodes.definition: To show or prove.

nodes.label: Create
nodes.definition: To bring into existence.

nodes.label: Analyze
nodes.definition: To examine in detail.

nodes.label: Predict
nodes.definition: To forecast or estimate.

nodes.label: Interpret
nodes.definition: To explain the meaning of.

nodes.label: Declare
nodes.definition: To state or announce.

nodes.label: Differentiate
nodes.definition: To distinguish between.

nodes.label: Explain
nodes.definition: To make clear or understandable.

nodes.label: Apply
nodes.definition: To put into practice.

nodes.label: Arrange
nodes.definition: To put in a specific order.

nodes.label: Control
nodes.definition: To direct or manage.
